verses.html: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.text: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

verses.html: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.text: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;

verses.html: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.text: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

verses.html: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
verses.text: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;

verses.html: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.text: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

verses.html: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
verses.text: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

verses.html: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.text: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

verses.html: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.text: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.

verses.html: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
verses.text: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.

verses.html: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.text: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

verses.html: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.text: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

verses.html: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.text: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;

verses.html: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.text: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

verses.html: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.text: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

verses.html: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
verses.text: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

verses.html: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
verses.text: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

verses.html: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.text: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

verses.html: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.text: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

verses.html: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.text: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

verses.html: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.text: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

verses.html: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.text: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

verses.html: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.text: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
